column1: # A DT_INIT_ARRAY constructor reserves a 48 GiB address region at main+0x89e8 and later allocations use fixed offsets up to alias +48.97 GiB, so the alias region must hold 49 GiB.
# The Mac gives every game at least the Switch's 64 GiB; iOS takes this row: 50 GiB, the most an iPad (M4, 16 GB) granted with the extended virtual addressing entitlement (64 GiB failed).
# mem_reserve is the alias region plus the 640 MB the provisional profile had besides it (256 MB in front, a 128 MB heap region, the 256 MB of stacks)
# the NPDM declares 4 MB of system resource
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the game asks for present interval 2 once, at window creation, and has no other limit; its logic runs on real time (60.0 fps at the same game-clock
# speed as 30, README.md Frame rate). Display mode presents at the cap by the present interval alone; the player's Frame rate picks 30 or 60
